Configuration Task Composition owns those independently bounded operations without broadening the old account/ship-to branch. After the FSM-only route check, create_account_ship_to_combined_fsm returns native_combined_create and verify_account_ship_to_combined_fsm returns native_combined_verify without GET; the bounded Combined Account and Physical Ship-To profile owns these operations. Otherwise create_account_number_fsm returns native_account_create and verify_account_number_fsm returns native_account_verify without a lookup; these operations use only their dedicated native account branch below. Likewise create_ship_to_assignment_fsm returns native_ship_to_create and verify_ship_to_assignment_fsm returns native_ship_to_verify without a lookup. create_location_code_fsm returns native_location_create and verify_location_code_fsm returns native_location_verify without a lookup. configure_initial_settings_fsm returns native_settings_configure and verify_initial_settings_fsm returns native_settings_verify without a lookup. create_document_routing_fsm returns native_routing_create and verify_document_routing_fsm returns native_routing_verify without a lookup. All other operations retain the following behavior. First apply FSM-Only Route Enforcement: runbook_rest_operation and assisted UI setup/execute return blocked locally without any external call. Otherwise only configure_document_messaging with an explicit connection invokes verify_cmksc_routing_connection_reference on the qualified current complete export supplied by its invoking workflow. Missing connection stops before operator context or routing preview.
